ingrid: Quick follow-up re: audit retention. Assessor asked for 90-day retention for evidence exports; our default exports retention is 30 days. Can we make an exception for this engagement?
morgan: We can create a project-level retention override for that presigned bucket. Ops will need to approve.
priya: Are we comfortable storing presigned objects for 90 days? Ops usually wants presigned links for 7 days max. Alternative: we can set a 30-day presigned link and export an archived copy to a long-term evidence bucket (90d retention) that the assessor can request via secure transfer.
ingrid: The assessor prefers direct access. They asked for explicit chain-of-custody timestamps. We should keep the original presigned objects but also snapshot them into the long-term bucket and log the checksum.
morgan: OK compromise: presigned link 30 days, snapshot copy to long-term evidence-archive with 90d retention. We'll include checksums and retention policy docs in the README.
priya: I'll add the archive step in the post-window runbook and capture md5s. Sample commands:```
gsutil cp gs://evidence-exports/assessments/175432/* gs://evidence-archive/assessments/175432/
gsutil ls -L gs://evidence-archive/assessments/175432/ > /tmp/archive-manifest.txt
```
security-bot: SEC-3188 updated: evidence retention policy note added. Assigned to priya.
